cold_open.hook: SpaceX just priced its IPO at $135 a share—and Elon's already hinting at a Tesla merger before the stock even trades.

markets.macro_note: Small caps outpacing tech; VIX down 9%, risk-on sentiment despite selective weakness in software and pharma.

big_story.story_title: SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell just gave another hint at a Tesla merger
big_story.angle: Shotwell's merger chatter is either a negotiation signal or a distraction from the fact that SpaceX's IPO prospectus still doesn't explain what the company actually does—and now retail investors are about to find out live.

quick_hits.angle: Justice Dept. rubber-stamps Paramount-Warner Bros. merger after months of theater; consolidation wins again, and the streaming wars just became a two-horse race.
Trump's name must come off the Kennedy Center by Friday—appeals court said no delays, so we're watching a real-time property dispute play out in federal court.
Value stocks are crushing growth by the widest margin in years; the narrative flip is real, but the question is whether it's mean reversion or a structural shift.
Trump administration says Iran deal signing is 'likely in coming days, but not 100% certain'—which is the diplomatic equivalent of 'we're working on it, but don't ask us when.'

odd_thing.joke_angle: Meta's AI unit is described as a 'soul-crushing gulag' by its own engineers—which is what happens when you hire brilliant people and tell them their job is to make ads slightly better at knowing you want sneakers.

yesterday_callback.topic: SpaceX raising $75 billion in record-setting IPO as Nasdaq debut awaits
